# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** eight-year-old  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P2](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** second-primer schoolboy  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) (sibling), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young man with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy, bright yellow ringlets. He has a snubbed nose and a single dimple in one cheek, which gives him a sweet and amusingly uneven appearance when he chuckles.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Robin is a mischievous, inquisitive child who frequently asks questions and pulls expressions. Characterized as a rascal, he approaches work with enthusiasm rather than sound judgment, though he can be careless and prone to forgetting. He harbors an ambition to become a shopkeeper who sells large quantities of candy and bananas, and he is easily comforted from his griefs by plum jam.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 IX A Question of Color P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +4 more_

## History

After becoming an orphan, Robin Farrow was brought alongside his twin sister, [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) with [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Known for his energetic nature and propensity for mischief, he frequently pulled pranks, such as enticing [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) into a pigpen and later locking her inside a toolhouse. When confronted about his behavior, he tearfully admitted that he did not realize lying was wrong, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to forgive his deceit while disciplining his actions. His antics continued to cause occasional household chaos, including an instance where he accidentally ruined lemon pies and later knocked down a heavy shell that shattered a borrowed platter. Following the death of [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md), a trust fund was established for Robin and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), enabling them to remain permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). During a severe storm that devastated the area, he sheltered safely at home with his sister, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +21 more_

## Quotes

> "You do not seem like the kind of lady who would lash a small boy simply because he was unable to stay motionless. Did you not find staying motionless terribly difficult when you were merely as old as I am?"
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "Thirza did the laundry yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scrubbed my skin using hard soap on the funeral day. For a single week, that suffices. Being so exceedingly clean seems pointless to me. Staying dirty is far more comfortable."
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "However, the caterpillar was so amazingly large . . . I grabbed him from the church steps right as we entered. Wasting him appeared to be a shame. Also, tell me, was it not amusing listening to that girl scream?"
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> "I only carried it out for amusement. Events have been extraordinarily quiet in this place for such a long time that I believed scaring you people immensely would prove entertaining. Indeed, it turned out to be so."
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “Why?” asked Robin, making himself comfortable and gazing upward with a tear-streaked, probing countenance. “Why is whopper not as good as falsehood? I want to know. It is an equally large word.”
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

## Relationships

### [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--robin-farrow.md)

Robin and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) are twin siblings brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) together after being orphaned. Robin frequently targets [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) with mischievous pranks, such as enticing her outside until she gets dripping wet, tricking her into jumping into a pigpen, and drenching her under a water pump. His trickery escalates to locking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse, which triggers a desperate search until she is located.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +17 more_

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +6 more</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--robin-farrow.md)

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) acts as an affectionate guardian and friend to young Robin. She frequently checks on him when he is disciplined for his antics, listening to his explanations, taking his confidences—such as secretly removing a toad he hid under Thirza's pillow—and defending the household adults when he tries to argue against their rules. Robin occasionally creates awkward moments for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), such as smashing a guest's platter during a lunch, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continues to look out for him and help guide his upbringing.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +11 more_

- Friend of — affectionate guardian and young friend  <sub>[v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P34](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0034), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)</sub>

### [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pettifer--robin-farrow.md)

Robin holds an affectionate admiration for Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), assisting him with tasks such as hauling dulse. However, Robin's mischievous behavior causes trouble on Mr. Pettifer's property, including an incident where Robin locks his sister [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), +2 more_

- Friend of — assisting him with hauling dulse and admiring him  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)</sub>

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/robin-farrow--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is Robin's cousin once removed and brings him and his twin sister to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) as their guardian. She enforces strict discipline over his energetic behavior, regularly punishing him with skipped dinners and confinement to his room when his tricks—such as hiding a toad under her pillow or locking up his sister—go too far. Despite Robin's attempts to challenge her authority or accuse her of dishonest threats, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) works constantly to determine how best to raise and correct him.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), +16 more_

- Serves under — guardian giving orders and imposing discipline  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P29](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0029)</sub>
- Relative of — third cousins once removed  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)</sub>
